idea-plugin.name: Sotto Icons
idea-plugin.description:
File and folder icons in the muted pastels of the Sotto theme.

  • File icons matched by file name and extension.
  • Folder badges matched by folder name.
  • Two styles, Color and Quiet, switched without a restart.
  • Class, package, source root, module and excluded folder icons stay the IDE's own.

Choose the style under Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Sotto Icons. Made to pair with the Sotto theme, and works with any dark theme.
